We are calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression. We are looking at the forebrain of humans, pigs and mice. The forebrain includes: cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus. 

For humans 

```{r}
total_human_elevated <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_human_elevated)
```

For Pigs 

```{r}
total_pig_elevated <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_pig_elevated)
```

For Mice 

```{r}
total_mouse_elevated <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_mouse_elevated)
```

The highest elevated gene expression was humans with 430 regionally elevated genes
